svg.title: Жим штанги лёжа с пола — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. BARBELL FLOOR PRESS. Both figures lie FACE UP directly on the FLOOR, knees bent and feet flat, NO bench. Front-side 3/4 view showing ground contact. Both hands grasp one barbell slightly wider than shoulders. Left: elbows bent, upper arms rest on floor, bar above lower chest, forearms upright. Right: arms extend vertically above chest, bar high over chest. Shoulder blades/back stay on floor; not a bridge or bench press. Whole bar and plates visible. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
